option_relations.rationale: Dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a broader category that includes Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa as a subtype.
Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (particularly DEB pruriginosa) is a broader category that includes Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa as a subtype.
Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (EBP) is the full name for the leaf Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa.

Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a distinct genetic form of epidermolysis bullosa, and while related to the broader category of dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, it is not directly equivalent to or a supertype/subtype of Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa in the context of the provided leaf.
